description: This file contains server-side load function and action handlers for managing a project task board in a Django-CRM application. It fetches board details, columns, and tasks, and provides actions to create, update, delete, and move tasks/columns.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Server-side loader function that fetches board data, columns, and tasks from API endpoints based on URL parameters.

methods.name: createColumn
methods.description: Action to create a new column in the board.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Action to create a new task within a specified column.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Action to update task details or move it to a different column.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Action to delete a specified task.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Action to move a task to a different column (drag-and-drop).
